## [1.0.0](https://github.com/awinogradov/code-assistants/compare/code-review-cost-monitor-action@v0.2.2...code-review-cost-monitor-action@v1.0.0) (2026-08-10)

## Release Notes

The monitor's autopilot skill directories have been renamed to a dash-only layout, making skills fully portable across Claude and other CLIs — but this requires immediate action on any existing synced paths.

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

### Autopilot Skill Directories Renamed to Dash-Only Paths

Skill directories previously used colon-separated names (e.g., `skills/pr:review/`). These have been renamed to dash-only equivalents (e.g., `skills/pr-review/`) to make the layout portable across Claude and other CLI tools. Slash commands themselves are unchanged, but anything that deep-links directly into the old colon-path directory structure will break.

**Migration steps:**

1. Update any external links, scripts, or documentation that reference colon-path skill directories to use their dash-only equivalents (e.g., `skills/pr:review/` → `skills/pr-review/`).
2. In your repository, manually remove any previously synced `autopilot-*` directories under `.agents/skills/`. The `agents-skills-sync` step now syncs the plugin's skills directory verbatim to unprefixed `.agents/skills/` paths — old `autopilot-*` directories will not be cleaned up automatically.
3. Remove any references to the generated `agent-skills/` directory and its export pipeline. This layout no longer exists; the plugin's skills directory is now the single portable source of truth per the new RFC-0002 standard.
